font.reason: Shorter, restrained Q tail; closer to locked visual reference than EB Garamond.

text_rules.rule: No text glyph may touch or cross the gold border or side divider arcs.

side_dividers.alignment: same optical radius as character midline

invariants: All circles and arcs share center (500,500).
Gold ring and side divider arcs are exactly 6 pt.
No text may touch/cross any gold line.
Text circle diameter is reduced from prior version.
All text paths use true circles, never ellipses.
Color variants change colors only; geometry remains identical.
